summary_markdown:
The TGI demographics data has been deployed to staging. However, the front-end work by [p1] is not yet complete. Additionally, a supplementary mapping was not reviewed, meaning the current scope only covers 32 clusters.

[me] noted that zero values exist (e.g., if no Asian demographic appeared in a specific mall). Consequently, filtering for Asians in this mall would result in zero impressions.

[me] attempted to multiply all figures by 100 and add 1 to prevent zeros from being strictly zero, but found this method ineffective or potentially misleading. [me] requested more robust solutions.
action_items: Develop a better solution for handling zero values in demographic data.
